tasks.short: Implement actual energy and transmission schedules

steps.what: Read the actual energy schedule and current transmission context; verify and capture intervals, quantities, identifiers and target fields
inputs: Actual schedule produced by scheduling staff
Current transmission information in the dispatch system
outputs: Checked schedule inputs and explicit target-field mapping

steps.what: Transfer exact verified energy-schedule fields into an unsubmitted transmission-reservation draft
inputs: Checked schedule and mapping from s1
outputs: Unsubmitted final reservation draft with exact intervals, quantities and route identifiers

steps.what: Make the actual real-time operational decision whether this exact reservation can be implemented under current network conditions and delegated dispatch authority
inputs: Actual current network conditions and dispatch authority
outputs: Current operational authority to submit the exact reservation, or a stop decision

steps.what: Actually submit the exact authorised transmission reservation or schedule through the existing scheduling interface
inputs: Exact reservation and current operational authority from s3
outputs: Actual submission and returned acceptance, rejection or pending status

steps.what: After the actual reservation response, confirm immediate readiness and actual authority for any specified equipment actions under current conditions
inputs: Actual current equipment and network conditions
outputs: Current decision to proceed with specified equipment actions or stop

steps.what: Implement the specified actual energy-schedule equipment actions using existing dispatch controls
outputs: Actual control actions and observed response

steps.what: Write and check the actual schedule-implementation entry from real submission and control outcomes
inputs: Actual submission status and actual control outcomes
outputs: Completed actual implementation entry

steps.what: Save the actual entry in the same dispatch log
outputs: Saved actual entry

tasks.design: In the existing dispatch and scheduling system, {OPS_SYSTEM}, transfer only exact fields from the actual schedule referenced in {DOCS} into an unsubmitted reservation. The dispatcher makes the real operational decision, performs the actual submission, reassesses current control readiness and implements actual equipment actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Schedule fields are manually re-entered into a reservation interface before real operational decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit field transfer can prepare the reservation without submitting it or controlling equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Real-time feasibility, counterparty responses and current network conditions require dispatch judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the schedule cannot be implemented as written and stop the actual action.

ambition.what: No greater network capacity or autonomous dispatch is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 to verify actual dispatch authority, interface access and change process

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact schedule-field transfer can prepare reservation drafts while current operational decisions, submissions and equipment control remain with dispatchers.

assumptions: Representative implementation episode involving an actual reservation and associated dispatcher equipment action. Other schedule types need their own observed sequence and duty mix. Scheduling staff produce the actual schedule during existing work; focal reading, verification and input mapping are counted fully in s1.

s1 supplies every interval, quantity, identifier and mapping used by s2. Missing or inconsistent data stop transfer and require actual manual correction. Use the existing system's native schedule interface first; an already automated transfer yields no new gain.

s3 and s5 are the real current operational authority and readiness decisions, not approval of the dispatcher's authored paperwork. a1 applies to the complete exact reservation after s2; any edit or network change invalidates it. Actual submission acceptance is never inferred. a2 follows the actual reservation response and is invalidated by any equipment or network change.

All actual submissions and controls remain human and fully retained. No automatic control, interlock, reservation send or equipment adjustment is hidden in the transfer. s7 is the real post-action implementation record, separate from control work and based only on actual outcomes.

Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving. Minimum integer share 1 represents negligible active save effort, fully retained. Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20; incremental upkeep 4 leaves net 16. Retained s1,s3-s7 labour is 79 already counted.
unknowns: Actual reservation and control authority sequence
research_questions: Observe an actual schedule implementation and identify exact field copying separately from operational decisions, submission and control.

already_counted.description: Source capture, real operational decisions, actual reservation submission, equipment readiness and control, and post-action entry remain in s1,s3-s7.

incremental.description: Maintain reservation mappings and tool-specific interface tests beyond ordinary dispatch checks.

approvals.approved_version: The exact completed reservation from s2 under current network conditions; any field or condition change requires a fresh operational decision
The specified equipment actions after the actual reservation response under current network and equipment conditions; any change requires fresh readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound removes 20 points of actual schedule re-entry. If native interfaces already handle 12 points, eligible gross is 8; 4 upkeep leaves 4. Fully native transfers require a lower estimate. No reduction is claimed for any actual operational decision or action.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate load estimates and control-setting requirements

steps.what: Read actual current load, topology and equipment records; verify and capture relevant values, units, timestamps and identifiers
inputs: Actual telemetry and equipment records in the existing dispatch system
outputs: Checked entered calculation inputs with source timestamps

steps.what: Specify the actual load or equipment calculation, scenarios, formulas and applicable constraints for the question
outputs: Explicit human calculation specification and assumptions

steps.what: Calculate load estimates and equipment requirements using the explicit specified formulas and entered inputs
inputs: Inputs from s1 and explicit formulas from s2
outputs: Reproducible calculated values with invalid inputs flagged

steps.what: Check calculations against actual source conditions and determine what required control settings the estimates support within uncertainty
outputs: Human assessment of required settings and limitations, without issuing controls

steps.what: Write and check the actual calculation working entry with source timestamps, assumptions and assessed requirements
outputs: Completed calculation entry

steps.what: Save the working calculation entry in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved working entry

tasks.design: Read actual source conditions in {OPS_SYSTEM} and use explicit formulas in {SPREADSHEET} for repeated calculations. The dispatcher checks estimates and determines supported requirements, then records the actual working calculation in {DOCS}; no settings are applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated explicit load and equipment calculations consume manual arithmetic effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calculation tools can repeat human-specified formulas on entered inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Valid assumptions, current topology and the operational meaning of estimates require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise stale or unsuitable inputs and avoid treating an estimate as control authority.

ambition.what: Compare another relevant load scenario without delegating operational judgement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to inspect actual engineering methods and source access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit calculation tools can repeat load or equipment arithmetic while method selection, current-condition checking and actual control decisions remain human.

assumptions: Representative calculation episode with observed repeated manual arithmetic and an actual working calculation entry. Existing telemetry and equipment staff produce source records in normal operation; their effort stays unchanged. Focal source checking and input capture are fully counted in s1.

s2 supplies every formula, scenario, constraint and assumption consumed by s3. Missing or stale data stop the calculation for manual investigation; no clean new topology feed or generated engineering formula is assumed.

Use the existing dispatch calculator first. Already native calculation execution yields no new gain. This design does not introduce a predictive model, new forecast service, automated control setting or safety component.

s4 retains original-source and arithmetic checking as well as assessing required settings. s5 separately counts the actual working record, not an invented report after every screen review. Actual implementation requires its own current authority and control steps.

Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving; share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible effort, fully retained. Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 30; incremental upkeep 4 leaves net 26. Retained s1,s2,s4,s5 labour is 69 already counted.
unknowns: Actual manual calculation and working-record requirements
research_questions: Inspect one actual load calculation and identify manual arithmetic separately from input validation and operational interpretation.

already_counted.description: Source capture, formula and scenario specification, original-source checking and actual calculation writing remain in s1,s2,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain calculation cases and formula tests beyond existing dispatch checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs 30 points of actual manual arithmetic. If native calculation already covers 20 points, eligible gross is 10; 4 upkeep leaves 6. Fully native calculations require a lower re-estimate. No operational action saving is included.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Track demand conditions and adjust actual equipment

steps.what: Read actual weather, demand and equipment-condition information using native time and area views
inputs: Existing weather information from the actual weather provider
Actual dispatch telemetry and demand information
outputs: Verified current condition context in the existing dispatch system

steps.what: Track conditions affecting power needs and assess whether anticipated changes require actual equipment adjustment
outputs: Human assessment of anticipated need and specified possible adjustment

steps.what: Confirm immediate actual readiness and delegated authority for the specified adjustment under current equipment and network conditions
inputs: Actual current network, equipment and authority
outputs: Current decision to perform the specified control action or stop

steps.what: Actually adjust the specified equipment through existing controls and observe its actual response
outputs: Actual adjustment and observed response

steps.what: Write and check the actual adjustment entry after observed action, reusing the verified existing equipment identifier
inputs: Existing equipment identifier verified in s1
outputs: Completed actual adjustment entry

steps.what: Save the actual entry in the same dispatch log
outputs: Saved actual entry

tasks.design: Configure native time and area views in the existing dispatch system, {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain human condition assessment, immediate action readiness and actual equipment adjustment; separately write the real post-action entry using exact equipment context.
tasks.previous_blocker: Condition views require repeated navigation and actual control entries repeat existing equipment identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and field context can reduce those clerical operations without choosing or executing a control action.
tasks.still_hard: Weather effects, current equipment state and operational trade-offs require real-time human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to actual conditions and stop a planned adjustment when circumstances change.

ambition.what: No autonomous response or increased operational capacity is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to inspect real display and log configuration permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native condition views and equipment-context fields can reduce navigation and repeated entry while actual power-control decisions remain human.

assumptions: Representative actual adjustment episode, not every monitoring interval. Weather providers and telemetry systems produce existing condition information during ordinary operation; focal reading and checking remain in s1. No new forecasting or clean structured weather feed is assumed.

s2 retains actual interpretation and adjustment choice. s3 is the immediate real operational readiness decision, not author self-approval. a1 applies only to the specified action under actual current conditions; any state or instruction change invalidates it.

s4 is the actual fully human control action and response observation. No model chooses controls, triggers an interlock or issues an adjustment. s5 separately counts the real required post-action record and uses only the existing identifier verified in s1.

The entry records actual completed action, never planned action as complete. Missing information requires manual investigation. Use native views and context first; existing features give no additional gain. Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20*0.10+9*0.10=2.9; upkeep 1 leaves net 1.9. Retained s1-s5 labour is 96.1 already counted. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Existing condition views and equipment-context fields
research_questions: Observe an actual demand-driven adjustment and separate display navigation, real-time judgement, control and post-action entry.

already_counted.description: Condition reading, demand assessment, immediate readiness, actual control and actual adjustment entry remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain native display and record context beyond ordinary dispatch checks.

approvals.approved_version: The specified equipment adjustment under actual current network and equipment conditions; any condition or instruction change requires fresh readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs repeated display navigation and identifier copying. If existing dispatch tools already remove both, no additional saving or new configuration upkeep is incurred. All actual operational decisions and actions remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record and compile operational transmission data

steps.what: Read actual transmission maps and source readings; verify tags, periods and units, enter non-digital readings and capture explicit log and aggregation mappings
inputs: Actual transmission maps and meter or chart readings
Existing historian values produced by the metering system
outputs: Checked tags, entered non-digital values and explicit mapping and aggregation rules

steps.what: Transfer exact existing historian readings and entered field values into the operational-log draft using the checked transmission-map mapping
inputs: Actual source values and explicit mapping from s1
outputs: Operational-log draft with exact timestamps, units and source references; missing data flagged

steps.what: Compile power demand, usage and operating-time summaries using the explicitly captured period and aggregation rules
inputs: Explicit period and aggregation rules from s1
outputs: Reproducible operational summaries with missing periods flagged

steps.what: Check compiled operational data against original readings and transmission maps; investigate gaps and write actual explanatory entries
outputs: Completed checked operational data and actual explanations

steps.what: Save the completed operational log in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved operational log

tasks.design: Transfer exact historian values from {DATA_PLATFORM} into the existing operational log in {OPS_SYSTEM}, using transmission-map mappings verified by the dispatcher. Compile explicit summaries, then retain original-source checking, gap investigation and actual explanatory writing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing readings are re-entered and operational totals compiled manually across logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historian transfer and explicit aggregation can reuse actual recorded values.
tasks.still_hard: Tag-map errors, missing intervals and unexplained operating changes require real investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a misleading aggregate and trace it back to actual plant or network evidence.

ambition.what: Inspect another relevant operational period when existing data support it.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to verify actual historian and dispatch-log access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: historian transfers and explicit operational-data aggregation can reduce re-entry while original-map checking and exception investigation remain human.

assumptions: Representative operational-log compilation episode with actual manual re-entry and aggregation. Metering systems produce existing historian values during ordinary operation; source-map staff produce actual transmission maps. Focal tag verification, aggregation-rule capture and all required non-digital reading entry are fully counted in s1.

s1 produces every tag mapping, unit, period rule and manually entered value used by s2-s3. Missing or incompatible values stop the affected transfer and require manual investigation, not imputation. No new clean telemetry service is supplied for free.

Use native historian connectors and summaries first. Existing automatic capture or aggregation is today's baseline and gives no new gain. The estimate applies only to observed remaining re-entry and compilation work, not to already automatic sensor execution.

s4 retains original reading and map comparisons, gap investigation and actual explanatory writing. No operational action, external submission, control change or compliance filing is hidden in log compilation. Those require distinct actual work and authority if required.

Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving. Minimum integer share 1 represents negligible active effort, fully retained. Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 30+15=45; upkeep 4 leaves net 41. Retained s1,s4 labour totals 54 already counted.
unknowns: Actual remaining manual re-entry and aggregation
Existing historian tag and transmission-map quality
research_questions: Trace one operational log from original readings and transmission maps to its compiled record and identify already native operations.

already_counted.description: Tag verification, non-digital capture, mapping, original-source checking, gap investigation and actual explanation writing remain in s1,s4.

incremental.description: Maintain historian mappings and aggregation tests beyond ordinary log checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs both manual source re-entry and manual aggregation. If a native historian connector already covers s2, only 15 compilation points remain eligible; 4 upkeep leaves 11. Fully automatic existing logs require a lower re-estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Scheduling staff producing actual energy schedules
Telemetry and metering staff maintaining source values
Transmission counterparties returning actual reservation status
skills_to_grow: Real-time operational judgement and authority discipline
Accurate post-action records and exception investigation
role.ambitious_version: A power dispatcher who spends less effort recopying schedules and operational data while retaining all actual operational decisions, submissions and equipment actions.
